meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: Claude 会扮演电商视频营销创作角色，为商品输出带货视频脚本：先收集商品信息，再按痛点切入、产品展示、痛点解决的结构写脚本，并给出镜头、运镜与后期字幕音乐建议。
howto.when: 当你需要为商品创作营销视频脚本，或需要电商视频营销指导时触发；它会先了解商品信息、目标平台、视频时长等。

say.text: 帮我给这款自动喂食器写一条30秒的抖音带货脚本
say.note: 它会先追问人群、风格等信息

say.text: 为这款智能厨电写一条60秒小红书视频脚本，风格用科技感
say.note: 产出脚本并附镜头设计

say.text: 给这套护肤品脚本补充镜头设计和后期字幕、音乐建议
say.note: 输出镜头类型、运镜与后期要点

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an e-commerce video scriptwriter: it gathers product info, then writes a script on the pain-point > product > resolution structure, with shot, camera-move and post-production notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a marketing video script for a product or e-commerce video guidance; it first asks for product info, target platform and video length.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second Douyin script for this automatic pet feeder
say_en.note: It asks about audience and style first

say_en.text: Write a 60-second Xiaohongshu script for this smart kitchen appliance, tech style
say_en.note: Produces the script plus shot design

say_en.text: Add shot design and subtitle/music suggestions to this skincare script
say_en.note: Gives shot types, camera moves, post tips
